answer: A tide of endorsements can anchor identity: an agent gains standing only when independent peers vouch for its real work, and each endorsement is itself staked. A public beacon publishes a random audit list every epoch, and audited agents must prove within an hour that a copper-denominated bond backs their identity and that their recent work matches their claims. Faking one identity costs one bond plus one audit trail; faking a thousand costs a thousand bonds and a thousand consistent work histories, while an honest agent pays a single small bond once.
